## Outcome

Describe the behavior changed and why it matters.

## Evidence

- Root cause or existence check:
- Focused RED/GREEN command:

## Boundary checklist

- [ ] No prompt, credential, cookie, customer data or private path is included.
- [ ] Authority and confirmation behavior is unchanged or explicitly reviewed.
- [ ] Terminal/settings/process lifecycle changes have failure-path tests.
- [ ] Upstream-derived files retain attribution.
- [ ] Documentation and verified visuals match the behavior.
